description: Lag processor limiting how fast its output can follow its input, with separate rise and fall times

params.text: Bends the slope, straight counter-clockwise and increasingly curved clockwise as the gap to the input shrinks
Sets how long the output takes to climb, from 1ms up to 100 seconds for a 10V step
Sets how long the output takes to drop, from 1ms up to 100 seconds for a 10V step

inputs.text: Lengthens the rise time, each volt cutting the slope further, and is added to the rise slider
Lengthens the fall time, each volt cutting the slope further, and is added to the fall slider

outputs.text: The input signal with its rate of change limited by the rise and fall times

notes: with the module bypassed the input is passed straight to the output
